correctness.rationale: The exact square covariogram gives the derivative probability density ((1+q)-2qt/T)/T on [0,T]. Its convergent real Mellin moment equals T^p(p+2-pq)/((p+1)(p+2)) for all p>-1. The limit p=0 is explicit. The log radial derivative factors as -(q-1)((p+1)q-1)/((1+q^2)(p+2-pq)); its denominator is positive. Sign cases yield all minima, and strict decreasing log(1+p/2)/p gives the unique p=2 axial/diagonal switch and its transverse slope. Symbolic exact arithmetic and finite numerical checks corroborate; no finite check substitutes for the all-real proof.
